# Fixtures

`application_settings_*.json` are application-settings documents.

## `pre_p4_*`: written before the P4 sidecar moves

These were generated by the Mere code at 31bf7ab3b, unmodified (the parent
tree of the commit that added them, "Pandect: fixtures written by the code
before the P4 sidecar moves"), so they predate every change in the sidecar
move. Nothing else in the tree changed when they were made. The generator was a
temporary `#[ignore]` test inside `graph_session.rs` (it needed the private
`MereSessions::create`), run once with `--features personal-sync` and removed
before the commit. The calls below are the ones it made. Ids are `Uuid::from_u128`
of the number shown.

- `pre_p4_sync_record_with_scene.cbor`: `p2panda_core::cbor::encode_cbor` of a
  `PersonalGraphRecord` with events `AddTag { node 1, tag "t" }` and
  `SaveScene { node 2, scene }`, parents `[[7; 32]]`, no writer attestation.
  The scene is a `SavedSceneV2` named "Shared scene" (selected 1, 2; layout
  "grid.default"; physics paused, damping 0.7, law "spring.rapier", overlays
  ["hubs"]; sources site/site/degree/roots; arrangement_pull 0.4; roles default
  "seeded", group example.com -> "anchored", item 1 -> "pinned"; dynamics
  `{"version": 9, "future": {"k": [1, 2.5, "x"]}}`; camera (12, 24) zoom 1.2;
  handler "graphshell.inspect"; cartography positions 1 -> (1.5, -2.25)).

`.gitattributes` marks `pre_p4_**` as `-text` so the bytes stay as written.

## `l7/`: written before declared-lens L7 changed any type (D18)

Generated by the Mere code at `c473cc8c3`, unmodified apart from
`mere-test-surface`'s `retained_statements` reader, which this commit adds. The
generator was a temporary `#[ignore]` test, `tests/l7_fixture_gen.rs`, run once
with `--features personal-sync` and removed before the commit. Ids are
`Uuid::from_u128` of the number shown; the asserter is `urn:l7:asserter`.

- `session/`: a `DirectoryBackend` store holding one minted session over the
  test surface. Surfaces `0x71` to `0x74` show `https://l7.test/a` to `d`. One
  edit asserts, through the legacy membership ensure, Semantic `Cites` (label
  "because") and Containment `UserFolder` from a to b, Imported `BookmarkFolder`
  from b to c and Provenance `CopiedFrom` from c to a, then the open predicate
  `https://l7.test/open` from a to c. A second upserts the exact statement
  `urn:l7:exact` (`rel#supports`, scope `Custom("urn:l7:scope")`, a basis with
  note, method and evidence, first and last times 1000 and 2000) from b to d and
  withdraws it at 3000. A third journals, between c and d, one row in the
  legacy sidecar shape: `families`, Semantic `Questions` with label "old",
  Containment `NotebookSection`, Imported `RssMembership`, Provenance
  `TranslatedFrom`, and no assertion records. Then the session flushes.
- `sync_record.cbor`: `encode_cbor` of a `PersonalGraphRecord` (parents
  `[[7; 32]]`) whose events add nodes a, b and c, assert version-1 Semantic
  `Elaborates` (`urn:l7:sync-semantic`, at 4000) and Provenance `MergedFrom`
  (`urn:l7:sync-provenance`, at 5000, a method basis) from a to b, assert legacy
  unversioned Containment `ClipSource` and Imported `SharedCollection` from b to c
  and Containment `UserFolder` from c to a, retract `Family(Containment)` from c
  to a, and retract `urn:l7:sync-provenance` at 6000.
- `expected.json`: the session id, the live pin's digest, and every retained
  statement, held or withdrawn, as `retained_statements` read them from the
  live session and from the record folded by the test surface's
  `StatementFold`. A legacy event names no statement, so its fold mints an id;
  `l7_replay.rs` compares those rows with the id masked.
